historySource.indexText: Proclaimed a national monument Jan. 16, 1908; redesignated as national park Jan. 10, 2013. Boundary changes: May 7, 1923; July 2, 1924; April 13, 1931; July 11, 1933; Dec. 5, 1941; Oct. 20, 1976; Jan. 11, 2000. Wilderness designated Oct. 20, 1976.
